type_hypothesis.against: Her self-description leans Two: "the classic do-gooder" (C04), "a supportive manager" (C14), "in my heart ... a people leader" and "an expert in people" (C56), "I really wanna help people that have, you know, less than I do" (C129), and "for the majority of our lives ... we've wanted to find something to work together on" (C151). Her career tracked Dario's across three eras and she recommended him to Brockman (C10, C132, C133, C152). She raised empathy as a hiring priority herself (C100) and her first no-ads reason is protecting users (C144). The OpenAI anger episodes (C19-C21, C135-C137) are disputed and Dario made the same facts-in-the-room move (C136). Against a rigid One: relaxed self-deprecation (C31, C31a), charity toward others' errors (C67), leaving Capitol Hill as "slow and bureaucratic" (C05, C86), retiring a value because not everyone loved it (C60), prizing changing one's mind (C61). She shows almost no first-person anger and named no trigger (C58, C82). Much of the One material is a president's job and her own account on promotional stages; "right thing" is house vocabulary (C73); the costly stands were collective and also built the brand (C147). Absence of loyalty talk does not discriminate because Dario shares it (C106).
type_hypothesis.alternative_case: Type 2 (strongest rival, the held hypothesis of the 2026-10-06 run): identity as supportive people leader (C14, C56), help-language motive (C129), lifelong wish to work with Dario (C151) and a career that tracked his (C152, C132), empathy as a hiring priority (C100), user protection as the first no-ads reason (C144), colleagues crediting the culture's niceness (C55). Why it trails: where warmth and a standard compete she says she picks candor over comfort (C140, C141), singles out sycophancy as the defect to train out (C103), describes the sibling bond as mutual accountability to values (C64), and unpacks "people leader" as fitting the best person to each problem, handing off interim roles accordingly (C153, C57). These are self-reports, and a Two who has learned candor helps could say them. Type 6 is a second live rival and is not cleanly excluded: fear of losing the company and doubt about her own conclusions (C27, C48), a mentor call before leaving (C23), a career alongside one trusted figure (C152), and her brother is typed 6 on the site (C72). The lean toward One is that her checks aim at error rather than threat (C156), a thin distinction. Nine fails on her own flat judgments and candor preference (C164, C66); Three is unlikely because she volunteers limits and mistakes (C157, C31).
type_hypothesis.discriminator: Which way she moves when warmth and a standard compete, in settings where a relational motive could surface: she ranks honest-but-imperfect feedback over smooth silence (C140), names a model that tells users what they want to hear as the hardest flaw (C103), describes her bond with Dario as mutual accountability to values (C64), and treats people work as fitting the best person to the job, including handing off her own interim roles (C153, C57); her self-binding procedures (C50, C51) and early fairness framing (C11, C81) are consistent. Limits: almost all of this is her own account on promotional or recruiting stages; it is role-confounded; it does not cleanly separate One from Six (C156); the absence of loyalty talk is non-discriminating (C106); the sibling register difference (C109) rests on one dated exchange and is not used as a discriminator; the OpenAI episodes (C19-C21, C135-C137) corroborate only. Named colleague testimony about how she reacts when someone misses a standard would discriminate better.
type_hypothesis.unexplained: Why a self-identified people leader whose reports call her supportive appears, in unnamed-source accounts, as the hard-edged process enforcer of the OpenAI years; how a high bar coexists with relaxed self-mockery (C31) and charity toward others' errors (C67); why her career tracked Dario's across three eras (C152) if her compass is principle rather than attachment; whether her distancing from the EA label (C33) is principled or reputational; how much of both the warmth and the rigor is the operator role beside Dario; and the near-absence of first-person resentment, which a One reading must treat as control or privacy rather than proof.
